features.title: Add one link, or five hundred
features.text: Paste links, one per line, or choose a .torrent file. You see the file name, category and folder before anything starts.

features.title: See what each download is doing
features.text: Speed, time left and connections for every file. When one waits or fails, it tells you why in plain words.

features.title: Files sort themselves
features.text: Six built-in categories go by file type, and each can have its own folder. Add your own, with your own file types.

features.title: Takes over from your browser
features.text: Register Chrome, Edge, Brave or Firefox, and the extension sends downloads to the app. The extension isn't in the browser stores yet.

features.title: Runs when you say
features.text: Choose how many downloads run at once, a speed limit, and the hours and days downloads may run.

features.title: Light or dark
features.text: Match your system, or choose one yourself in Settings, Appearance.
